release_notes: v9.8.28 — REVERT iter-107 paren/apostrophe/quote escaping in SVCURRENTCOMPANY. Field data from Krishna Sales Corporation confirms v9.8.25 (raw company name) worked on Tally Prime 7.0, while v9.8.27 (with `(` → `(`, `)` → `)`, `'` → `'`, `"` → `"`) failed with `Could not set 'SVCurrentCompany'`. Diagnosis: Tally's TDL matching layer does NOT decode numeric character references or `'`/`"` back to literal chars when matching against the loaded-company catalog — so the escaped string is compared literally and never matches. v9.8.28 keeps only the three strictly XML-mandated escapes (`&` → `&`, `<` → `<`, `>` → `>`) which every conformant XML parser (Tally included) DOES decode. Parens / single-quote / double-quote are sent raw — they are perfectly legal inside XML element content. Customer-side: rebuild .exe from current source, drop into frontend/public/FlowraTallyAgent.exe, update sha256+size_bytes here, push to droplet.
